entities.name: Query protein (369 aa)
observations: Sequence-based analysis finds 66.2% identity and 98.6% query coverage to reviewed Opitutus terrae RlmN (UniProt B2A0B9).
Pfam hits: RlmN_N (PF21016.4), residues 12–66; Radical_SAM (PF04055.28), residues 118–291.
Close reviewed RlmN homolog annotations indicate methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA; inferred function, not experimentally demonstrated for this query.
Homolog annotations indicate a [4Fe-4S] cluster and S-adenosyl-L-methionine-dependent radical-SAM chemistry; predicted cytoplasmic localization.
Sequence-derived length 369 aa; estimated mass 42.1 kDa; theoretical pI 9.40; net charge at pH 7 approximately +13.2.

entities.name: RlmN (B2A0B9)
observations: Reviewed Opitutus terrae RlmN homolog; 66.2% identity and 98.6% query coverage to the analyzed sequence.
Annotated as a dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase acting on 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37, with [4Fe-4S] cluster and SAM-related radical-SAM chemistry.
